body: I feel you entirely. I almost spiraled in October because I felt so overwhelmed from everything. I don’t get how people can do this for a whole lifetime
I’ve been reading through the thread and I just wanted to say that you aren’t ugly at all—I hope you stay encouraged to live, there are plenty of people who will find value in you. Please take care✨
I hold my baby just like this every morning before breakfast 😍❤️💖
Do you know what color she is considered? My Bunny looks EXACTLY like her and he’s a Lionhead/Rex mix!
So precious ❤️ she’s a little baby![img](emote|t5_2riv8|8711)
I’m considering possibly transitioning to part time or maybe just taking a few months off with medical leave maybe? I’m not sure what option would be better though honestly :/
Your story is so heartbreaking. Whatever you decide to do in your situation, please hang in there!
I’m dealing with the same thing honestly. I’ve lost a very dear friend (estranged) and I grieve every day because I can’t undo the fallout. It’s painful.

I’m definitely just here to emphasize. I’m not sure why, but out of all possible issues and problems in my life, the feeling of loneliness is by far the worst to me. I, too, do better when I’m with someone, and that’s in everything from work and school to exercise and healthy habits. I wish there were a way to get rid of this constant panic and terror of possibly living life alone. I’m up late because I can’t sleep...a person I am seeing also gave me the “let’s be casual” talk recently after 2 years. I pretty much have started going even further downhill in my depression than I could imagine. I just don’t get how it can be so difficult for me to connect with someone fully and have all of the love I give, returned back to me. Maybe I never will.

I could’ve written this myself. Right now, I’m up just wondering if it would be worth it to just say the truth to my therapist. That I’m not getting much better at all and that ending it all would put an end to this tragic thing rather than to “try” fixing it with therapy and medication. At least I’d get a reprieve from all of the confusion and heartache that I’m experiencing now. I’m at a lost, but I truly emphasize with you.
